caption:
Your rule breaches. Every pending order cancels immediately. When a threshold is hit, the server-side kill switch cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, keeps the account locked until close, and re-fires if trading activity reappears.

KaatDo operates as a server-side kill switch on six supported brokers using official trade APIs. kaatdo.com काट दो.

KaatDo is not investment advice and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
